speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand your wife is concerned about your behavior; can you tell me what has been happening with you lately that led to this visit?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those are very serious experiences to go through, and it must be frightening to feel like your mind is being controlled. To help me understand what is happening, have you heard any voices or seen things that others around you do not see or hear?

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying that you have no history of substance abuse, which helps rule out drug-induced psychosis. To further narrow down the diagnosis, have you experienced any significant changes in your sleep patterns or energy levels over the last three months?
